scope: short-only research challenger; no live, long, policy, or execution contract change

architecture.conversion: frozen T5 low-regret ordinal; train only prior resolved opportunity-positive rows; score every candidate
architecture.stacking: inner chronological OOF O/C predictions only; K0 analytic mixture, K1 product plus isotonic, K2 hierarchical 5x5 shrinkage

causality.outer: fit rows require label_available_at before held month start
causality.inner: mapper consumes only chronological OOF O/C predictions
causality.inference: no realised MFE or conditional opportunity gate is used
causality.invalidity: invalid/incomplete paths are excluded from fitting and outcome metrics, never encoded as failures

validation.prediction_coverage: 16,748 target-free held candidates per arm receive finite O and C outputs; no future-MFE inference gate
validation.prequential_lineage: 1,008,182 inner OOF rows; zero label_available_at violations relative to their outer held month; C fit support 666..5,761 prior opportunity-positive rows
validation.economic_gate: opportunity discrimination passes, but 2024 strict support is only Sep-Dec, 2025 has a negative month, and 2026 CVaR is worse than M4; no promotion
